# Overview

## Data

- learn about the training input and critically assess what this input includes
- learn about Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback, the human in the loop of creating GenAI chatbots
- learn about the consequences of their design regarding their outputs 
- learn why the use of such systems has claimed to lead to "automated plagiarism"

## Interaction

- how large language models differ from humans by design
- how GenAI chatbots have been constructed and marketed to make human-chatbot interaction seem "human-like" and "engaging"
- the consequences thereof for the way we interact with such systems 


## Privacy

- what personal data actually is - and why it includes much more than your name and (email-)address 
- how digital services collect, combine and infer information about people
- how data protection principles such as data minimisation, purpose limitation and transparency apply to digital technologies
- why Generative AI creates particular challenges for data protection


## Security

- what information security actually means - and why it is not simply a matter of having a strong password
- how GenAI chatbots can create new security risks when they code, process documents, webpages, messages or confidential information
- what prompt injection is and why instructions from an AI system cannot automatically be trusted
- how GenAI chatbots can be used by attackers for phishing, social engineering and other forms of manipulation
- why both users and organisations have a role to play in using GenAI systems securely

## Environment
